I had posted about this in /v/serialkillers awhile back but I think it fits the theme of being unexplained too. This case is one of the more popular serial killers so some might be familiar with the story. The Original Night Stalker is particularly freaky me to primarily because there is a brazen and extremely callous nature to his crimes. He apparently sometimes brought a dog with him and would spend time in the victims home. He seems to have graduated from breaking and entering, to rape, and eventually murder. He also called at least one his earlier victims years later to taunt here. The crimes caused intense panic. At a town-hall meeting a man stood up and chastised the audience to the effect that no real man could be subdued and allowed his wife to be raped. A short time later, the Night Stalker seemed to intentionally target the man and his wife. After being active from 1976 to 1986 he seemed to stop but did make the phone call in 1991. There's uncertainty if he was arrested for something else, somehow killed, or simply moved to another geographic location.
